sensitivity.change: If {{feature}} importance changed from {{current}}% to {{suggested}}%, {{alternative}} would become the top-ranked policy instead of {{currentPolicy}}. The other weights are rescaled proportionally.
sensitivity.method: This is a deterministic sensitivity calculation over 1-percentage-point changes between 5% and 80%. Gemini does not calculate or change the ranking.
